definition: to make something new like a product
description: A messy workshop at night under a skylight. A young woman in paint-stained denim overalls with goggles on her head rides a silver suitcase that has a glowing blue wheel, arms out for balance and mouth open in surprise. Behind her a long line of earlier broken suitcase models lies on the floor, sketches of the design are pinned to the wall and a 3D printer sits on a table. Her friends in the background watch from a sofa, then jump and cheer, one holding a bowl of noodles.

taps.phrase: to hold a bowl of noodles
